name: Namor the Sub-Mariner — power-only CDA keeps printed toughness
notes: Memory: project_namor_single_char_cda_2026-06-04. 'Namor's power is equal to the number of Merfolk you control' set no CDA, and a symmetric CDA would have clobbered toughness. Here: Namor (Merfolk) plus Silvergill Adept (Merfolk) = 2 power; toughness stays the printed 4. Grizzly Bears and the opponent's Silvergill Adept must not count.
